recovered_from: Uploaded ai-quant-platform-zero-cost-ready.zip source constants and original research conversation
expected_volume: median of log1p(quote_volume), prior 30 same-UTC-open-time slots, minimum 14 observations
bucket_comparison: current value strictly below threshold; equality enters higher bucket
forward_rv: sqrt(sum of squared close-to-close log returns over bars t+1 through t+h))
excess_metrics: actual / prior 30 same-slot median - 1, minimum 14; zero denominator treated as missing

bootstrap.contrast: mean metric in 90%+ minus mean in under 80%

interpretation: Market effect study, not a trading strategy or profit backtest. Bootstrap tail fraction is not a calibrated hypothesis-test p-value. Horizon and regime results are descriptive Discovery evidence.
